obfuscation_indicators: known and unknown risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantitative information on sales, margins, store count, closures, expenses, and tax judgments, but includes substantial forward-looking safe-harbor and promotional language. Risk factors include declining demand, inflationary and labor pressures, supply-chain disruption, accounting restatement history, failed web-platform implementation, store closures, and uncertainty around tax and cost recoveries.
